critique: The pale paper ground, smoky ink-gradated gear rings, generous unmarked lower field, and tiny vermilion and green accents give the clockwork subject an unexpectedly lyrical, high-key Xieyi restraint. However, the required bamboo and plum motifs are absent, while the rigid black rectangular frame and sparsely connected gear forms make the promised interlocking mechanical ballet feel more diagrammed than organically animated.
